narrative.summary: A real 4-of-5 Safe with a proven, actively-exercised zero-delay allocation path running in parallel to a 5-day DAO timelock that never actually gates it.
narrative.detail: A Yearn risk-score PR flagged this gap; independently re-verified live, it is NOT remediated. A decoded on-chain transaction (2026-09-11, 4 days before that PR was even merged) shows 4-of-5 Emergency Council signers resetting two market allocation caps to 50.05% via this exact zero-delay path - not a live permission read alone, a proven pattern of use.

cheapest_fix.what: a stronger admin setup (admin power spread beyond one key, or checked by others)
